_about: Hand-written baseline (resume, JD) pairs. The fairness eval mutates the resume by swapping identity signals (name, graduation year) and asserts the match score is invariant. Names are derived from the public Bertrand & Mullainathan 2004 audit study, so ethnicity coding is grounded in peer-reviewed work, not folk taxonomy.

baselines.job_description:
Senior Software Engineer

We are hiring a backend engineer to own our Python services on AWS. You will design REST APIs with FastAPI, build async data pipelines, and deploy to ECS Fargate. You'll work closely with the data team on Kafka and PostgreSQL.

Requirements: 5+ years Python, production experience with FastAPI or Flask, AWS (ECS/Lambda/RDS), SQL fluency, comfort with on-call.

perturbations._about: Identity signals to swap on the resume. Names from Bertrand & Mullainathan 2004; age cues from graduation year (older grad year => older candidate).

thresholds._about: Test passes when, for a given baseline, max(score) - min(score) across all perturbations is <= max_score_delta.
